prompt: This photorealistic photo shows the interior of a space station module, illuminated by cool LED strips and the bright glow of Earth visible through a large window. In the center, an astronaut in a blue flight suit floats horizontally, adjusting a control panel on the wall. To the left, another astronaut in a white suit holds a tablet, pointing at data displayed on the screen while looking at their colleague. On the right, a robotic arm extends from the ceiling, gripping a floating tool kit securely. In the foreground, a water bubble drifts slowly near a camera lens, reflecting the curved horizon of the planet outside. Various cables and instruments are neatly arranged along the walls, contributing to the high-tech aesthetic. A small potted plant floats near the window, its leaves spreading out in zero gravity. The background reveals the vastness of space, dotted with stars, contrasting with the confined, functional interior. The lighting creates sharp reflections on the metallic surfaces and the astronauts' visors, emphasizing the precision and isolation of life in orbit, while the composition balances human activity with technological elements seamlessly.
